purpose: Define the authoritative input and ownership contract for Hero-detail header/basic information before enrichment extraction begins.

policy: heroId is the only canonical join key.
Display names are presentation values and must not be used as join keys.
The existing 267-record verified identity master must be reused; Stage 5-5 must not rebuild playable-Hero identity from ConfigData.

headerSchema.note: Use the reviewed canonical identity master rather than re-reading HeroInfo.Name_Eng as a new identity authority.

prohibitions: Do not interpret legacy HeroInfo Field 16 / ExchangedFragmentCount as rarity.

headerSchema.note: A canonical Hero-to-faction source has not yet been accepted by the Hero page pipeline.
Do not synthesize or infer voice-actor metadata without an accepted source.
The recovered field name is only a candidate until its page-display semantics and coverage are validated.
The ID field may identify character-image data, but asset-path resolution and presentation coverage require separate validation.
Skin membership alone is insufficient for the page contract; release order and acquisition metadata must be preserved when available.

candidateConfigDataFields.semanticPolicy: A recovered field name does not by itself prove final page-display semantics, completeness, ordering, or join behavior.

ownershipBoundaries.combat: Hero Stage 4 output remains the authority for normal combat/stat/job/skill data and is not a header metadata source.
ownershipBoundaries.soldiers: Hero Stage 5-3 frozen output remains the authority for usable-Soldier page data.
ownershipBoundaries.bonds: HeroInformation_ID and HeroInformation-related bond/fetter data belong to Hero Stage 5-1 unless independently proven necessary for header display.
ownershipBoundaries.sp: SP existence and SP-specific page data remain Hero Stage 5-4 owned.

presentationRules: Header/basic information is keyed and assembled by heroId.
Missing enrichment metadata remains null/review; never fabricate display values.
Artwork and skin metadata are presentation enrichment and must not alter canonical Hero identity.
Skin ordering must preserve release order and acquisition metadata when a validated source is available.
Base and SP presentation may share header identity, but SP-specific switching behavior is not owned by Stage 5-5.
prohibitions: Do not rebuild the 267-Hero canonical set in Stage 5-5.
Do not use names as relational keys.
Do not use HeroInfo.ExchangedFragmentCount as a rarity enum.
Do not promote a ConfigData field from candidate to authoritative display metadata solely because its field name is readable.
Do not mix Stage 4 combat calculations into the header/basic-information schema.
Do not synthesize missing Korean names, CVs, factions, origins, rarity labels, artwork mappings, skin ordering, or acquisition metadata.
completionRule: Stage 5-5-1 is complete when canonical identity reuse, header field ownership, candidate-source boundaries, non-synthesis policy, and the exact pending-enrichment list are frozen. Actual enrichment extraction and coverage validation belong to Stage 5-5-2 and later 5-5 substages.
nextStage: 5-5-2: validate authoritative sources and coverage for rarity, factions, CV, origin, artwork and skins without reopening canonical Hero identity.
